The Nexus Property Management® franchise located in downtown Pawtucket, RI has been locally owned and operated since 2013. Living up to its reputation as the Property Management Authority®️, Nexus services over 700 rental units in Rhode Island and Southeastern Massachusetts, all within a 30 minute drive of the state capital. Providence is the largest and most populous city in the state and like its neighboring industrial cities in Southern New England, it is bursting with real estate investment opportunities. From Woonsocket in the north, to Cranston and Warwick further south, Nexus provides unrivaled property management throughout Rhode Island for single family homes, condos, and entire apartment buildings.

If you know your Rhode Island geography, you’ve likely noted that Nexus specializes in servicing urban centers along the Blackstone River and Narragansett Bay. It is our goal to be part of the revitalization of these once thriving business and commerce centers (check out our home office in downtown Pawtucket). There was a time when areas like East Providence were the gateway between the industrial Northeast to the rest of the world. Today, what’s left across the region is infrastructure that is ripe for residential investment and improvement. While other property managers may prefer to focus on wealthier suburbs with primarily single family homes, Nexus is dedicated to finding often overlooked opportunities for growth within multi-family units in rebounding cities like Central Falls and Pawtucket. Although these areas may seem intimidating to the untrained novice or some of our corner-cutting competitors, with Nexus Property Management® in your corner, these are opportunities for win-win relationships where your portfolio grows along with the quality of living for our tenants.

By embracing technology, we simplify rent collection, fill vacant units faster than others, and make communication as easy as can be. With an in-house maintenance department we add value to your property for much less than industry averages. We pride ourselves on our professionalism, transparency, and efficiency and you’ll see evidence of this throughout our website and customer reviews. We are dedicated to serving our clients 365 days a year, 24 hours a day.

Our team also manages rental properties in nearby Attleboro and North Attleboro, Massachusetts. Other Mass. locations nearby are now managed by Nexus Property Management’s Fall River Franchise Office and our Worcester Franchise Office.

At Nexus, our goal is not just to collect the rent and act as a substitute, like most property management companies, but instead we pride ourselves on our ability to add value to owners’ assets. This leads to longer tenant tenures and ultimately more profit and less headaches for our clients. Nexus also provides property analysis, profit forecasts, and buyer’s agency through our Nvest® program for those investors looking to add to their portfolios.

Nexus Property Management® is dedicated to connecting our owners and tenants alike to better living. Contact us for more information and take note of our transparency and stellar local reputation. With our professional guidance, Nexus clients and the tenants we place for them will learn firsthand why Nexus Property Management® is the fastest growing property manager in Rhode Island and Southeastern Massachusetts.

After decades of real estate management and investing, we decided to offer our expertise and services to other property owners in Rhode Island & Southeastern Massachusetts and have since franchised nationwide! Nexus Property Management® brings years of experience. With practices and procedures perfected over time we are able to increase equity for our clients while simultaneously providing great service to our tenants. This efficiency allows us to provide a better experience for tenants and owners than many companies who don’t invest themselves. Most real estate companies are primarily brokerages and focus on sales, with property management often being a small side business for them if they even offer it. Because we are property owners ourselves and our business is exclusively focused on property management, we bring an eye for detail with a foresight to handle potential problems and issues, many times before they arise. Property management is our business. This is why you will get great management and peace of mind from contracting our services. We are the company that will give your properties the attention they deserve and "Connect You To Better Living®".
Nexus Property Management® can greatly benefit any property owner, but you may especially want to consider hiring Nexus Property Management® if any of the following things are true.
You live further than a few minutes away from your rental property
You are not, or don't want to become a home maintenance guru
You would rather spend your free time on things other than tasks related to your rental property
You dislike phone calls at 2am about a broken pipe and can not be available 24/7 in case of emergency
You don’t have a good working knowledge of landlord-tenant law
You do not want to deal with tenant conflicts or nonpaying tenants

Let Us Manage Your Providence, RI Rental Property
Are you a rental property owner in Providence, Rhode Island? Are you tired of dealing with day-to-day management tasks and repair issues? If so, Lyon Property Group can help!

Our team of experienced professionals is dedicated to providing top-notch property management solutions for rental property owners in Providence and the surrounding areas. Lyon Property Group has been in the RI property management business for over 20 years, serving clients throughout Rhode Island and Southeastern Massachusetts. Our headquarters are conveniently located in North Attleboro, MA, allowing us to easily access and manage rental properties in Providence and the surrounding areas. We specialize in managing various kinds of rentals, including single-family homes, multi-family units, and commercial properties. Our team at Lyon Property Group understands the unique challenges and hard work of owning rental properties in Providence. From navigating local regulations to handling requests, we have the knowledge and expertise to ensure your real estate investment is well-maintained and profitable. We are committed to providing our clients with personalized service and communication, ensuring you are always informed and involved in managing your investment.

Contact Lyon Property Group today if you’re ready to take the stress out of rental property ownership! Let us handle the day-to-day management tasks and ensure the long-term success of your real estate investment.

Lyon Property Group offers comprehensive property management services to help landlords navigate the complexities of property ownership. Our team of professionals is dedicated to making this easier and more profitable, with a wide range of customizable services designed to meet your unique needs.
Below are our top services for property owners:

At Lyon Property Group, we understand that finding reliable and responsible tenants is the key to successful rental properties. That’s why our property managers offer all our owners thorough tenant screening services. Our screening process includes a comprehensive background check, credit check, and rental history verification to ensure that each potential tenant meets our high standards. We also conduct in-person interviews to understand their character and personality. By carefully selecting renters, we can help reduce the risk of late rent payments, property damage, and other issues that can arise with problematic renters.

Marketing properties is essential for attracting potential tenants and keeping rentals occupied. At Lyon, we use a variety of marketing channels to promote your property, including online listings, social media, and local advertising. We take professional photos of your rental and highlight its unique features and amenities to make it stand out. With our marketing expertise, we can help you find high-quality renters quickly and efficiently.

A solid lease agreement is critical for protecting your property and setting clear expectations. At Lyon, we provide comprehensive leasing agreements covering all aspects of tenancy, from rent payments to repair responsibilities. Our property managers work with you to customize the lease agreement to meet their needs and ensure all legal requirements are met. Our property management team handles all aspects of the leasing process for our clients, from preparing the documents to reviewing them with renters and overseeing signings.

Collecting rent can be a time-consuming and challenging task for landlords. When you work with a property manager from Lyon Property Group, they will collect rent for you, ensuring that payments are received on time and in full. We also offer online payment options, making it easy for tenants to pay their rent and reducing the risk of late or missed payments.

Maintenance and repairs are a part of owning a rental property, but they can be a hassle for landlords. At Lyon Property Group, we handle all property maintenance and repairs, from routine to emergency. We work with a network of trusted contractors to ensure that repairs are done quickly and correctly. Our goal is to keep your property in excellent condition and reduce the risk of costly repairs down the line.

To ensure that your property is well-maintained throughout the tenancy, your property manager conduct a thorough move-in inspection with each new tenant. We carefully document the property’s condition and note any existing damage or issues. This inspection helps us establish a baseline for the property’s condition and ensure that any future damage is the tenant’s responsibility.

Regular property inspections are essential for identifying maintenance issues or safety concerns before they become significant problems. At Lyon Property Group, we conduct routine inspections of our client’s rental properties to ensure everything is in good condition. We promptly address any maintenance issues and work with owners to schedule necessary repairs. During these inspections, we thoroughly examine the property’s interior and exterior, including appliances, plumbing, electrical systems, HVAC, roofing, and structural components. Our inspections are conducted by experienced professionals trained to identify potential issues before they become major problems. If we identify any maintenance or safety concerns during the inspection, we address them promptly and work with you to schedule any necessary repairs. We have a network of trusted contractors who can handle everything from routine maintenance to emergency situations. Our goal is to keep your property in excellent condition and ensure the safety and satisfaction of your tenants.

Providence, Rhode Island, is a vibrant and historic city in New England’s heart. As the capital city of Rhode Island, Providence boasts a rich cultural heritage and a thriving arts and entertainment scene. From world-class restaurants and museums to beautiful parks and waterfront attractions, there’s something for everyone in Providence.

For property owners and investors, professional support can make a major difference in maximizing returns and maintaining asset value. Our full-service property management solutions in Providence are designed to handle everything from tenant relations to day-to-day operations.

Providence is also a great place to live or invest in real estate. The city has a diverse mix of neighborhoods, each with unique character and charm. From historic Brown University and the East Side to the eclectic Federal Hill and the trendy West End, there’s a neighborhood in Providence for everyone.
Before investing, many owners benefit from a detailed rental analysis to understand potential income and market performance in the area.
If you own larger residential buildings, our specialized multifamily management services can help streamline operations and improve long-term profitability.

Providence has something to offer whether you’re a first-time homebuyer or an experienced real estate investor. With its vibrant cultural scene, beautiful parks and waterfront attractions, and diverse neighborhoods, it’s easy to see why so many people call Providence home.
For landlords preparing a unit for the market, strategic upgrades can significantly increase rental value and reduce vacancy time. Learn more about our renovation services here.

Let Us Manage Your Rhode Island Multi-Family Property

Do you own a multi-family rental property in Rhode Island or Eastern CT and are looking for a management team to maximize your investment returns? Lyon Property Group specializes in multi-family property management, ensuring your properties are expertly cared for and consistently profitable. With years of proven experience, we offer a tailored approach to maximize occupancy rates, streamline maintenance, and deliver exceptional tenant experiences. Our company thrives on creating strong client relationships, maintaining top-tier property conditions, and maximizing returns for our clients through proactive and innovative management strategies. Whether you’re seeking consistent rent collection, tenant screening, or hands-on property maintenance, Lyon Property Group’s commitment to efficiency and professionalism makes us the best partner to manage and elevate your investment success.
Our Multi- Family Rental Management Services
Our Multi-Family Rental Management Services are designed to maximize your property’s value, minimize your stress, and deliver exceptional experiences for both you and your tenants.

Effective marketing is crucial to reducing vacancy times and ensuring maximum profitability for your multi-family rental property. At Lyon Property Group, we take a strategic approach to marketing your rental units, employing proven strategies to reach a broad yet targeted pool of prospective tenants. Our marketing services include creating high-quality property listings with professional photos, engaging descriptions, and optimized content that highlights your property’s best features.

We use a mix of online rental platforms, social media, local advertising channels, and SEO-driven marketing strategies to ensure maximum exposure. Additionally, we provide scheduled open house events and virtual tours to attract quality renters quickly, minimizing downtime and maximizing your return on investment.

Choosing the right tenants is the most important part of successful multi-family property management. Lyon Property Group employs a thorough tenant screening process to ensure that you get reliable, long-term residents who respect your property and make timely payments. Our comprehensive approach includes background checks, employment and income verification, rental history reviews, and credit assessments. We adhere to all fair housing laws, maintaining a balanced and lawful process that protects you as a property owner. By focusing on tenant quality, we reduce the risks associated with late payments, lease violations, and property damage, offering you peace of mind and predictable rental income. When you partner with Lyon Property Group, you can trust that your property is in responsible hands.

Efficient rent collection is key to the success of any rental property. Our team at Lyon Property Group takes a proactive approach to collecting rent, ensuring that your cash flow remains steady and predictable. We offer tenants multiple payment options, including online portals that make paying rent easy and accessible.

Automated payment reminders help prevent late payments, while our streamlined follow-up process ensures timely collections. In cases where rent remains unpaid, our experienced team enforces lease terms consistently and takes all necessary steps, including late fee assessments and legal procedures when necessary. This efficient and tenant-friendly system minimizes missed payments and maximizes your revenue.

Property upkeep and repairs are essential for preserving your investment’s value and keeping tenants happy. Lyon Property Group offers a full-service repair and maintenance program to keep your multi-family properties in excellent condition.

Our experienced maintenance team handles routine tasks like plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and landscaping, as well as more urgent repairs through our 24/7 emergency maintenance services. We partner with trusted local vendors, ensuring prompt service and cost-effective repairs. Preventive maintenance schedules are implemented to identify potential issues before they become costly problems. Our commitment to quality repairs and consistent maintenance not only prolongs the life of your property but also fosters tenant satisfaction and retention.

Understanding the financial health of your rental property is crucial to making informed business decisions. Lyon Property Group provides detailed financial reporting that keeps you informed every step of the way. Our reports include income statements, expense reports, rent roll summaries, and maintenance cost breakdowns. These easy-to-read reports are accessible through our online owner portal, giving you a transparent view of your property’s performance and profitability at any time. Our team works closely with you to answer questions, provide insights, and ensure your investment goals are being met. Whether you need monthly reports, annual statements, or custom financial analytics, we are committed to delivering clarity and confidence when it comes to your property’s financial health.

Lyon Property Group stands out as a premier partner for property owners across Rhode Island and Southern Massachusetts, offering a personalized approach to managing multi-family rental properties. With years of experience and a dedication to excellence, our team has built a reputation for delivering results-driven solutions tailored to maximize property value and enhance tenant satisfaction. What makes us truly special is our commitment to treating every property as if it were our own—bringing a level of care, attention to detail, and innovative strategies that consistently exceed expectations. Property investors choose Lyon Property Group because we prioritize their success through proactive and transparent management practices. Our expert team focuses on boosting occupancy rates, reducing turnover, and enhancing your property’s appeal through targeted marketing, rigorous tenant screening, and high-quality maintenance services.

With us, you gain access to cutting-edge technology, an experienced maintenance team, and comprehensive financial reporting that provides a crystal-clear view of your property’s performance. Unlike many other firms, we blend our local market expertise with a client-first approach, building lasting relationships based on trust, responsiveness, and results. For investors seeking peace of mind and the assurance that their multi-family assets are in capable hands, Lyon Property Group is the partner to choose. We not only protect and enhance your investment but also create thriving communities that attract quality tenants and yield consistent profits. Your success is our mission, and we bring the skills and passion necessary to help you achieve it.
